   1 class_name UISystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 
   5 func setup() -> void:
   6 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   7 
   8 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
   9 	return q.with_all([C_Session, C_UIState]).enabled()
  10 
  11 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  12 	for entity in entities:
  13 		if not entity.enabled:
  14 			continue
  15 		var session: C_Session = entity.get_component(C_Session)
  16 		var state: C_UIState = entity.get_component(C_UIState)
  17 		state.visible_screen = session.mode
  18 		state.snapshot = runtime.get_run_snapshot()
  19 		state.prompt = ""
  20 		for interaction in state.snapshot.interactions:
  21 			if interaction.selected and interaction.available and session.mode == "playing":
  22 				state.prompt = "E · " + interaction.prompt
  23 		if state.notice != session.message:
  24 			state.notice = session.message
  25 			state.notice_left = 6.0
  26 		elif session.mode == "playing":
  27 			state.notice_left = maxf(0.0, state.notice_left - delta)
  28 		if is_instance_valid(runtime.ui_root):
  29 			runtime.ui_root.present(state.snapshot, state)
